June 12, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Managed Asset Portfolios Llc increased its stake in Seaworld Entmt Inc (SEAS) by 19.32% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Managed Asset Portfolios Llc bought 74,293 shares as the company’s stock rose 13.21% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 458,733 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.80 million, up from 384,440 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Managed Asset Portfolios Llc who had been investing in Seaworld Entmt Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.86B market cap company. It closed at $21.01 lastly. It is up 2.14% since June 12, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.71% the S&P500. Cypress Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Boeing Company (BA) by 30.1% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cypress Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Boeing Company for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $215.79B market cap company.
